description:
﻿Modern, high-performance music player with dynamic UI

Void Player is a premium, open-source local music player for Android, crafted with Kotlin Multiplatform and Jetpack Compose.

Designed with a heavy emphasis on modern UI aesthetics, dynamic colors, and buttery smooth performance, without any ads, trackers, or hidden analytics.

Key Features:

  • 100% Free & Open Source: No ads, no trackers, no telemetry, completely offline.
  • Bottom Navigation Bar: Sleek navigation with Library, AI Hub, Playlists, and Now Playing.
  • Dedicated Now Playing Screen: Dynamic gradient extracted from album art with swipe gestures.
  • Void AI Insights: Analyzes your library to discover your musical personality, vibe breakdown, and recommended EQ.
  • AI DJ Smart Flow: Predicts and queues smooth-transitioning next tracks based on tempo and mood.
  • AI Smart Categorization: Automatically organizes tracks into Night Vibes, High Energy, Deep Focus, Romance, and Quick Hits.
  • Hi-Res Audio Codec Inspector: Detects FLAC (24-bit/96kHz), WAV, AAC, and 320kbps MP3 with interactive details.
  • Synchronized Lyrics & LRCLIB: Real-time LRC viewer with auto-scroll, tap-to-seek, and automatic LRCLIB online fetching with offline caching.
  • Persistent Playlists & Favorites: Save and restore playlists and favorite tracks across restarts.
  • Playback Speed & Sleep Timer: 0.5x to 2.0x speed controls and gentle volume fade-out timer.
  • Hardware Equalizer & DSP: 5-band hardware EQ, BassBoost (0-1000 strength), and real-time loudness normalization via Android DynamicsProcessing.
  • Live Queue: View and jump between upcoming tracks directly in the player.
